sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是“99%隐秘史”。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗马·马尔斯。

sentences.en: There's this photograph tacked on the wall here in the studio.
sentences.zh: 工作室的墙上挂着这样一张照片。

sentences.en: It was taken in 1899.
sentences.zh: 它拍摄于1899年。

sentences.en: The photo shows three men, all wearing bowler hats, two of them in bow ties.
sentences.zh: 照片里有三个男人，都戴着圆顶礼帽，其中两人系着领结。

sentences.en: They're looking dead on into the camera with this casual look of conqueSt.
sentences.zh: 他们直视着镜头，带着一种漫不经心的征服感。

sentences.en: Knees raised, hands on hips, suspended mid-air on the lifted arm of a giant dredging machine.
sentences.zh: 膝盖抬起，双手叉腰，悬在巨大挖泥船升起的吊臂中空。

sentences.en: A machine used to force the natural environment to bend to the will of humans.
sentences.zh: 这是一台用来迫使自然环境顺从人类意志的机器。

sentences.en: Even if you don't know this image in particular, you've seen images like it.
sentences.zh: 即使你对这张照片不熟悉，你也见过类似的影像。

sentences.en: Scenes of people standing around proudly, looking good as they shaped the earth.
sentences.zh: 人们自豪地站在四周、意气风发地改造大地的场景。

sentences.en: What fascinates me about the pictures from this time is that they speak to this moment
sentences.zh: 这些时期的照片让我着迷的地方在于，它们诉说了一个时刻：

sentences.en: when there was a real sense of awe and reverence for the marvels of civil engineering.
sentences.zh: 那时人们对土木工程的奇迹充满了真正的敬畏与崇敬。

sentences.en: Now, I don't mean to over-romanticize this stuff.
sentences.zh: 当然，我并不是想把这些过度浪漫化。

sentences.en: A lot of things we did for the sake of progress were ethically dubious, if not outright horrible.
sentences.zh: 我们为了进步所做的好多事情，在道德上都值得怀疑，如果不是彻底的可怕的话。

sentences.en: There were mountains tunneled, hills flattened, swamps drained.
sentences.zh: 曾经凿穿山脉、削平丘陵、排干沼泽。

sentences.en: But the environmental impact notwithstanding, these feats of engineering weren't just amazing for their time.
sentences.zh: 但抛开环境影响不谈，这些工程壮举不仅在当时令人惊叹。

sentences.en: They're amazing for our time.
sentences.zh: 在今天看来同样惊艳。

sentences.en: The photo I'm talking about, the three guys in bowler hats on the dredging machine,
sentences.zh: 我刚才说的那张照片，三个戴圆顶礼帽的家伙站在挖泥船上，

sentences.en: is a scene from the reversal of the Chicago River.
sentences.zh: 是芝加哥河改道工程中的一个场景。

sentences.en: And the reason that photo is famous, or at least famous enough for me to have seen it,
sentences.zh: 这张照片之所以出名，或者说至少出名到让我能看到它，

sentences.en: is because the reversal of the Chicago River was an enormous engineering project that was successful.
sentences.zh: 是因为芝加哥河改道是一个取得巨大成功的工程项目。

sentences.en: See episode 86, True Believers.
sentences.zh: 参见第86期“忠实信徒”。

sentences.en: But you've got to figure, there were countless other photographs depicting similarly awe-inspiring feats of engineering prowess
sentences.zh: 但你可以想象，还有无数其他照片记录了同样令人惊叹的工程壮举

sentences.en: that we have never seen.
sentences.zh: 是我们从未见过的。

sentences.en: Because those feats never got finished.
sentences.zh: 因为那些壮举从未完成。

sentences.en: They were, you could say, failures.
sentences.zh: 可以说，它们失败了。

sentences.en: Today we have the story of one such failure, which, before people finally gave up on it,
sentences.zh: 今天我们要讲的就是这样一个失败的故事，在人们最终放弃它之前，

sentences.en: probably also once included a moment of men posing on machinery.
sentences.zh: 可能也曾在某个时刻记录过人们在机械前摆姿势的场景。

sentences.en: So actually, I do have a photo we can start from, dated to 1892.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，我确实有一张可以作为开端的老照片，拍摄于1892年。

sentences.en: Reporter Julia Barton grew up in Dallas, Texas, where our story takes place.
sentences.zh: 记者朱莉娅·巴顿在德克萨斯州达拉斯长大，我们的故事就发生在那里。

sentences.en: These men, a few of them in bowler hats, are standing on a wide, flat boat with a winch on top of it.
sentences.zh: 这些男人，其中几个戴着圆顶礼帽，正站在一艘宽而平的船上，船顶上装有绞盘。

sentences.en: A chain and a hook dangle down from the winch, and they're hauling up a tree stump.
sentences.zh: 一根链条和一个钩子从绞盘上垂下来，他们正在拉起一截树桩。

sentences.en: The boat's in a narrow, muddy river, and it's surrounded by huge piles of broken-up trees
sentences.zh: 船行驶在一条狭窄、浑浊的河流中，周围堆满了巨大的碎树桩

sentences.en: and other debris floating in the water.
sentences.zh: 以及漂浮在水中的其他杂物。

sentences.en: The boat's name?
sentences.zh: 这艘船叫什么？

sentences.en: Snagboat Dallas of Dallas.
sentences.zh: 达拉斯的达拉斯号 snagboat（打捞船）。

sentences.en: Oh man, I love that name.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我太喜欢这个名字了。

sentences.en: Growing up in Dallas, I never saw pictures of things like the snagboat Dallas of Dallas.
sentences.zh: 在达拉斯长大的我，从未见过像“达拉斯的达拉斯号打捞船”这样东西的照片。

sentences.en: I never heard of the failed project that generations of Dallas people spent their lives pursuing,
sentences.zh: 我从未听说过那个让一代代达拉斯人穷尽一生去追求的失败项目，

sentences.en: even though it concerns an engineering project so massive
sentences.zh: 尽管它涉及一个如此庞大的工程项目：

sentences.en: that it was once compared to both the Panama Canal and the Great Pyramids of Giza.
sentences.zh: 它曾一度被拿来与巴拿马运河和吉萨大金字塔相提并论。

sentences.en: This is the story of the Port of Dallas.
sentences.zh: 这就是达拉斯港的故事。

sentences.en: If you know anything about Texas geography, you probably at least know that Dallas is not close to the ocean.
sentences.zh: 如果你对德克萨斯州的地理有所了解，你大概至少知道达拉斯并不临海。

sentences.en: At all.
sentences.zh: 一点也不。

sentences.en: It's more than 300 miles to the Gulf of Mexico.
sentences.zh: 距离墨西哥湾有300多英里。

sentences.en: That's like trying to build a port to the Pacific Ocean in Reno, Nevada,
sentences.zh: 这就好比试图在内华达州里诺市修建一个通往太平洋的港口，

sentences.en: or a port to the Atlantic in eastern Tennessee.
sentences.zh: 或者在田纳西州东部修建一个通往大西洋的港口。

sentences.en: But unlike Reno or eastern Tennessee,
sentences.zh: 但与里诺或田纳西州东部不同的是，

sentences.en: Dallas is at least located on a river that flows to the ocean, the Trinity.
sentences.zh: 达拉斯至少位于一条流向海洋的河流——三一河（Trinity River）畔。

sentences.en: In Dallas, though, the Trinity is really low and very narrow.
sentences.zh: 不过在达拉斯，三一河的水量真的很小，河面也非常窄。

sentences.en: So narrow that there are stories of Dallas's first ferry boat on the Trinity
sentences.zh: 窄到有这样的传说：达拉斯在三一河上的第一艘渡轮

sentences.en: turning itself sideways to act as a bridge from time to time.
sentences.zh: 有时甚至会把船身横过来充当临时桥梁。

sentences.en: So the Trinity was not a great way to move people or farm crops to the sea.
sentences.zh: 所以三一河并不是运送人员或农作物出海的好途径。

sentences.en: But neither was the alternative.
sentences.zh: 但备选方案同样好不到哪去。

sentences.en: In the early days of Dallas in the 1840s and 1850s,
sentences.zh: 在1940和1850年代达拉斯的早期岁月里，

sentences.en: if your goods weren't getting moved on a boat,
sentences.zh: 如果你的货物不是用船运送的，

sentences.en: they were in the back of a wagon getting pulled by a team of oxen.
sentences.zh: 那就是装在由一群公牛拉着的马车后厢里。

sentences.en: Railroads came to Dallas in 1872,
sentences.zh: 铁路于1872年开通至达拉斯，

sentences.en: but railroad companies could and did raise their rates whenever they felt like it.
sentences.zh: 但铁路公司能够也确实在他们高兴的时候随时提高运费。

sentences.en: Dallas leaders wanted river navigation to keep access to the outside world affordable.
sentences.zh: 达拉斯的领导人们希望通过内河航运来保持与外部世界相连的低廉运费。

sentences.en: But in addition to being low and narrow,
sentences.zh: 然而除了水浅河窄之外，

sentences.en: the Trinity River is incredibly long and winding.
sentences.zh: 三一河还极其漫长且蜿蜒曲折。

sentences.en: So even though Dallas is about 300 miles to the ocean as the crow flies,
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管按照直线距离计算，达拉斯距离海洋大约300英里，

sentences.en: with all the trinities meandering, it's closer to 700 miles of river.
sentences.zh: 但算上三一河所有蜿蜒的河道，水路距离接近700英里。

sentences.en: The few boats that made it to Dallas from the Gulf took nearly a year doing it.
sentences.zh: 从墨西哥湾一路到达拉斯的少数几艘船花了将近一年时间。

sentences.en: One of them was the aforementioned snag boat Dallas of Dallas,
sentences.zh: 其中一艘就是前面提到的达拉斯号打捞船，

sentences.en: which cleared debris called snags out of the water to make the river navigable to steamships.
sentences.zh: 它清理水中的障碍物（称为snags），好让汽船能够通航。

sentences.en: One of the first of those was the steamboat H.A.
sentences.zh: 其中最早的一艘汽船是H.A.

sentences.en: Harvey Jr.
sentences.zh: 小哈维号（Harvey Jr.）。

sentences.en: When the H.A.
sentences.zh: 当H.A.

sentences.en: Harvey Jr.
sentences.zh: 小哈维号

sentences.en: finally made it to Dallas in 1893,
sentences.zh: 终于在1893年抵达达拉斯时，

sentences.en: the city went nuts.
sentences.zh: 全城都陷入了疯狂。

sentences.en: There was a massive parade.
sentences.zh: 举行了规模浩大的游行。

sentences.en: The local paper printed its front page in red ink.
sentences.zh: 当地报纸用红墨水印刷了头版。

sentences.en: It was a huge day, and they declared Dallas had become a port city as a result of that.
sentences.zh: 那是个伟大的日子，他们宣布达拉斯因此成了一座海港城市。

sentences.en: Even the city directories, like the 1901 city directory,
sentences.zh: 甚至连城市名录，比如1901年的城市名录，

sentences.en: describes Dallas as a port city.
sentences.zh: 都把达拉斯描述为一座海港城市。

sentences.en: That's Dallas historian Darwin Payne.
sentences.zh: 说话的是达拉斯历史学家达尔文·佩恩（Darwin Payne）。

sentences.en: And the dynamic he's describing here in the city directory is very important when it comes to Dallas.
sentences.zh: 他在城市名录中描述的这种动态，在谈到达拉斯时非常重要。

sentences.en: There's the actual version of events, and then there's this grossly optimistic version.
sentences.zh: 现实中发生的事情是一回事，而这种极度乐观的版本则是另一回事。

sentences.en: And as I was researching this story, this kind of booster-y salesman voice kept coming at me in different forms,
sentences.zh: 当我在研究这个故事时，这种带有宣传性质的推销员腔调一直以各种形式向我袭来，

sentences.en: telling me that something that was absolutely untrue absolutely was true.
sentences.zh: 告诉我一件绝对不真实的事情绝对是真实的。

sentences.en: We had Dallas-born actor William Jackson Harper voice various clippings from the written record
sentences.zh: 我们请来了出生于达拉斯的演员威廉·杰克逊·哈珀（William Jackson Harper）为三一河项目长达130年历史的书面记录中的

sentences.en: of the 130-year-old history of the Trinity Project.
sentences.zh: 各种剪报配音。

sentences.en: Here he is, as the Dallas Times-Herald in 1893, insisting,
sentences.zh: 这是他在扮演1893年的《达拉斯时报先驱报》时，坚称：

sentences.en: The navigation of the Trinity is not a possibility.
sentences.zh: 三一河的通航不是一种可能。

sentences.en: It is an accomplished fact.
sentences.zh: 它是一个既成事实。

sentences.en: Yeah, the H.A.
sentences.zh: 没错，H.A.

sentences.en: Harvey made it.
sentences.zh: 哈维号成功了。

sentences.en: But that's just one boat.
sentences.zh: 但这只是一艘船。

sentences.en: For more boats to follow, the river would have to become easier to navigate.
sentences.zh: 要让更多的船只随之而来，这条河必须变得更容易通航。

sentences.en: And remember, this is the era of getting s**t done.
sentences.zh: 记住，这是一个大刀阔斧实干的时代。

sentences.en: We gotta move the river?
sentences.zh: 我们得把河改道？

sentences.en: Fine, let's move the river.
sentences.zh: 行吧，那就改道。

sentences.en: Dallas convinced Congress to survey the river and figure out where locks and dams could help make it navigable.
sentences.zh: 达拉斯说服了国会去勘测河流，并找出哪里可以修建船闸和水坝来帮助其通航。

sentences.en: The Army Corps of Engineers finished the first lock and dam in the early 1900s
sentences.zh: 陆军工兵部队在20世纪初完成了第一座船闸和水坝的建设，

sentences.en: at a site 13 miles below Dallas.
sentences.zh: 地点在达拉斯下游13英里处。

sentences.en: But eventually, Congress shelved the project.
sentences.zh: 但最终，国会搁置了这个项目。

sentences.en: The locks and dams that had already been built moldered.
sentences.zh: 那些已经建好的船闸和水坝开始腐朽。

sentences.en: The locks and dams along the river stood deserted and moss-covered.
sentences.zh: 河边的船闸和水坝荒废着，长满了苔藓。

sentences.en: And just as it had done before the white man came to Texas and wrested an empire from the wilderness,
sentences.zh: 就像白人来到德克萨斯、从荒野中夺取一个帝国之前所做的那样，

sentences.en: the Trinity River, muddy, unclean, and turtle-infested,
sentences.zh: 浑浊、不洁、布满水龟的三一河，

sentences.en: wound sluggishly between its banks in sullen victory.
sentences.zh: 带着阴沉的胜利姿态，在河岸间迟缓地蜿蜒流淌。

sentences.en: But then, the port of Dallas caught a second wind.
sentences.zh: 但随后，达拉斯港迎来了第二春。

sentences.en: The Trinity may have been turtle-infested, but it wasn't always sluggish.
sentences.zh: 三一河可能布满水龟，但它并不总是流速缓慢。

sentences.en: In 1908, the river flooded, and it made a mess of Dallas.
sentences.zh: 1908年，河水泛滥，把达拉斯搞得一团糟。

sentences.en: It turned downtown Dallas into a peninsula surrounded by raging floodwaters.
sentences.zh: 它把达拉斯市中心变成了一个被汹涌洪水包围的半岛。

sentences.en: It devastated the city, and as a result of that, Dallas hired George Kessler to create what was known as the Kessler Plan.
sentences.zh: 洪水给这座城市带来了毁灭性的打击，因此，达拉斯聘请了乔治·凯斯勒（George Kessler）来制定后来被称为“凯斯勒计划”的方案。

sentences.en: Kessler was a famous urban planner, European-trained, but he'd spent part of his youth in Dallas.
sentences.zh: 凯斯勒是一位著名的城市规划师，在欧洲受过培训，但他的部分青少年时期是在达拉斯度过的。

sentences.en: He created a vision for the city that included boulevards and parks.
sentences.zh: 他为这座城市勾勒了一个包含林荫大道和公园的愿景。

sentences.en: But the part that really excited Dallas leaders was how Kessler reimagined the meandering Trinity.
sentences.zh: 但真正让达拉斯领导人兴奋的是，凯斯勒是如何重新构想那条蜿蜒曲折的三一河的。

sentences.en: He envisioned it becoming a straight channel about a half mile west of its existing course through Dallas.
sentences.zh: 他设想将其变成一条笔直的河道，位于其穿过达拉斯原有河道以西约半英里处。

sentences.en: Levees would contain the new channel and open up miles of floodplain for development right next to downtown.
sentences.zh: 堤防将围合出新的河道，并在市中心旁开放数英里的洪泛区供开发。

sentences.en: Basically, they moved the river out of downtown.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他们把河流从市中心移开了。

sentences.en: Even if you do know the geography of Dallas, it's hard to picture exactly what this means.
sentences.zh: 即使你了解达拉斯的地理，也很难想象这究竟意味着什么。

sentences.en: The project was even bigger than you would think, because it involved changes in the roadways going over,
sentences.zh: 这个项目比你想象的还要宏大，因为它涉及跨河道路的改建、

sentences.en: the sewer systems and utility connections, and a huge earth-moving project, of course.
sentences.zh: 下水道系统和公用设施连接，当然，还有一个巨大的土方工程。

sentences.en: Suffice it to say, this was the kind of enormous project where there'd be pictures of giant machines topped by men in bowler hats.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，这是一个到处都是戴着圆顶礼帽的男人站在巨型机器前拍照的宏大项目。

sentences.en: Well, by now we're talking 1928, so fedoras would have been more in style.
sentences.zh: 好吧，到了这个时候已经是1928年了，所以呢子软帽（fedoras）可能更流行一些。

sentences.en: And so, starting in 1928, the river-moving project was a go.
sentences.zh: 因此，从1928年开始，河道改道项目正式启动。

sentences.en: The city of Dallas dug the Trinity, a 26-mile straight-shot channel with tall levees on either side of it, a half mile apart,
sentences.zh: 达拉斯市开挖了三一河，那是一条长达26英里、笔直的河道，两侧是高高的堤防，相距半英里，

sentences.en: perfect for the commercial barges that had now replaced steamboats.
sentences.zh: 非常适合现在已经取代了汽船的商业驳船。

sentences.en: And make no mistake, the historical record shows that even though this massive project was on its face about flood control,
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，历史记录显示，尽管这个庞大项目表面上是为了防洪，

sentences.en: Dallas leaders at the time saw this as the resurrection of the Port of Dallas.
sentences.zh: 但当时的达拉斯领导人将其视为达拉斯港的复活。

sentences.en: So in 1930, you got another ceremony for the Port of Dallas.
sentences.zh: 所以在1930年，你又迎来了一场针对达拉斯港的庆典。

sentences.en: A bottle containing the sweet, sweet waters of the Gulf of Mexico,
sentences.zh: 一个装有墨西哥湾甘甜海水的瓶子——

sentences.en: the final destination of the Trinity River, was smashed over a dredging machine as people cheered on.
sentences.zh: 那是三一河的最终归宿——在欢呼声中被砸在了一台挖泥船上。

sentences.en: A local pastor gave the benediction.
sentences.zh: 当地的一位牧师作了祝祷。

sentences.en: May these engineers in vision see the coming millions who, when our virgin acres are upturned to the smiles of God
sentences.zh: 愿这些有远见的工程师们看到未来的千百万人，当我们的处女地迎着上帝的微笑被翻开，

sentences.en: and our fabulous resources developed, shall people this empire.
sentences.zh: 当我们的神话般资源被开发时，他们将在这片土地上繁衍生息。

sentences.en: They really liked the land on thick in those days.
sentences.zh: 那时候他们真的很喜欢这种夸张的调调。

sentences.en: And from there, the plan to build the Port of Dallas was really underway.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，建设达拉斯港的计划真正展开了。

sentences.en: There was the general will for it, there was political clout behind it, and there was eventually money to fund it.
sentences.zh: 有普遍的民意支持，有政治影响力作为后盾，最终还有资金来资助它。

sentences.en: The Army Corps of Engineers came up with a really big plan to change the whole course of the Trinity to allow boats up to Dallas.
sentences.zh: 陆军工兵部队提出了一个宏伟的计划，准备改变三一河的整个流向，以便让船只能够开进达拉斯。

sentences.en: And even further upstream to Fort Worth.
sentences.zh: 甚至还要一直延伸到上游的沃思堡（Fort Worth）。

sentences.en: President John F.
sentences.zh: 约翰·F·

sentences.en: Kennedy, just a month before he was assassinated in Dallas,
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪总统在他在达拉斯遇刺前的一个月，

sentences.en: signed off on a huge $900 million spending package for the Trinity.
sentences.zh: 批准了一笔高达9亿美元的三一河专项开支计划。

sentences.en: And despite the PR nightmare that befell Dallas after JFK's death, the River Plan kept on moving forward.
sentences.zh: 尽管JFK去世后达拉斯陷入了公关噩梦，但河道计划仍在继续推进。

sentences.en: After all, the new president, Lyndon B.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，新总统林登·B·

sentences.en: Johnson, was a Texan, and he was in favor of the project.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊是个德克萨斯人，而且他赞成这个项目。

sentences.en: Here he is talking on the phone in 1968 with Fort Worth Congressman Jim Wright.
sentences.zh: 这里是他在1968年与沃思堡国会议员吉姆·赖特（Jim Wright）通电话的录音。

sentences.en: Jim?
sentences.zh: 吉姆？

sentences.en: Mr. President?
sentences.zh: 总统先生？

sentences.en: How are you getting along?
sentences.zh: 你近来怎么样？

sentences.en: Okay, how are you, sir?
sentences.zh: 还好，您呢，先生？

sentences.en: Well, I've had a long, hard week, but a good one, I think.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我度过了漫长而艰难的一周，不过我想也是收获不错的一周。

sentences.en: Let me ask you...
sentences.zh: 我问你个事……

sentences.en: Say, did we get, we got your Trinity thing set up, didn't we?
sentences.zh: 我说，我们把你们那个三一河的事给弄妥了吧，是吧？

sentences.en: Sure as hell did, and I think we're working on the thing.
sentences.zh: 千真万确，我想我们正在推进这件事。

sentences.en: Well, I guess that'll be the major cronyism of the campaign.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我想这会是这场竞选最大的裙带作风。

sentences.en: Well, I hope it doesn't hurt you.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我希望这不会对你不利。

sentences.en: It sure as hell helps the rest of us.
sentences.zh: 这对我们其他人可是大有帮助。

sentences.en: Dallas was ready.
sentences.zh: 达拉斯已经准备好了。

sentences.en: In anticipation of the soon-to-be navigable Trinity River,
sentences.zh: 为了迎接即将通航的特里尼蒂河，

sentences.en: new freeway bridges constructed over the river were built extra tall to allow seagoing vessels clearance underneath.
sentences.zh: 横跨河流的新高速公路桥梁建得格外高，以便让远洋船只在下方通过。

sentences.en: Most bridges are constructed 15 to 20 feet above existing terrain,
sentences.zh: 大多数桥梁建在高于现有地形 15 到 20 英尺的地方，

sentences.en: while these two high-rise viaducts rise to well over 60 feet.
sentences.zh: 而这两座高架高架桥的高度则远超 60 英尺。

sentences.en: One reason is so they may handle the hoped-for and sought-after barge traffic
sentences.zh: 原因之一是它们可以应付人们翘首以盼的驳船交通，

sentences.en: the Trinity proponents claim will pour into the Dallas-Fort Worth area.
sentences.zh: 特里尼蒂河的支持者声称这些驳船将涌入达拉斯-沃斯堡地区。

sentences.en: It's been 130 years.
sentences.zh: 已经过去 130 年了。

sentences.en: That's about 115 years longer than it took to build the Great Pyramid of Giza.
sentences.zh: 这比建造吉萨大金字塔所花的时间长了大约 115 年。

sentences.en: Dallas is finally becoming a port city.
sentences.zh: 达拉斯终于要成为一个港口城市了。

sentences.en: Think of what this means.
sentences.zh: 想想这意味着什么。

sentences.en: Sailors loose on shore leave.
sentences.zh: 上岸休假的船员。

sentences.en: Riverboat gambling cruises.
sentences.zh: 内河游船赌博。

sentences.en: Heavy industry.
sentences.zh: 重工业。

sentences.en: Loading docks.
sentences.zh: 货运码头。

sentences.en: Fishermen.
sentences.zh: 渔夫。

sentences.en: Longshoremen.
sentences.zh: 码头工人。

sentences.en: Stevedores.
sentences.zh: 装卸工。

sentences.en: Romantic picnics on the levees.
sentences.zh: 在防洪堤上浪漫野餐。

sentences.en: But then the port of Dallas hit a snag, so to speak.
sentences.zh: 但随后达拉斯港遭遇了挫折，可以说是出师不利。

sentences.en: It went out not with a bang, but with the whine of a jet turbine engine.
sentences.zh: 它的消亡没有伴随轰鸣，而是在喷气涡轮发动机的哀鸣声中结束。

sentences.en: The great irony is that while all of this was taking place in the early 1970s,
sentences.zh: 极具讽刺意味的是，正当这一切在 20 世纪 70 年代初发生时，

sentences.en: Dallas and Fort Worth were building an international airport.
sentences.zh: 达拉斯和沃斯堡正在建设一座国际机场。

sentences.en: Rob Tranchin is a film producer who made a documentary about the Trinity
sentences.zh: 罗布·特兰钦是一位电影制片人，他为达拉斯公共电视台 KERA

sentences.en: for Dallas' public TV station, KERA.
sentences.zh: 制作了一部关于特里尼蒂河的纪录片。

sentences.en: He says the massive DFW airport invigorated the new economy growing here.
sentences.zh: 他说，庞大的沃斯堡机场为这里不断增长的新经济注入了活力。

sentences.en: Dallas was de-industrializing.
sentences.zh: 达拉斯正在去工业化。

sentences.en: The city had moved from its reliance on agriculture and trade to technology,
sentences.zh: 这座城市已经从依赖农业和贸易转向了技术、

sentences.en: light manufacturing, banking, and insurance.
sentences.zh: 轻工业、银行和保险业。

sentences.en: Companies like Texas Instruments were on the rise.
sentences.zh: 像德州仪器这样的公司正在崛起。

sentences.en: They didn't need barges to reach the outside world.
sentences.zh: 他们不需要驳船来接触外部世界。

sentences.en: They had an airport.
sentences.zh: 他们有机场。

sentences.en: In my considered judgment, the canalization of the river would probably make Dallas
sentences.zh: 在我看来，对这条河进行运河化可能会让达拉斯

sentences.en: go the way of the other port cities with a polluted channel, which Houston has,
sentences.zh: 走上其他拥有受污染水道的港口城市的道路，就像休斯顿那样，

sentences.en: increased crime and increased deterioration of the inner city.
sentences.zh: 带来犯罪率上升和内城日益衰败。

sentences.en: That's Alan Steelman, who ran for Congress in Dallas in 1972.
sentences.zh: 那是艾伦·斯蒂尔曼，他在 1972 年竞选达拉斯的国会议员。

sentences.en: He ran against the Trinity Canal.
sentences.zh: 他反对特里尼蒂运河。

sentences.en: It likely would mean the location of steel mills and petrochemical plants
sentences.zh: 这很可能意味着这里将建立钢铁厂、石化工厂

sentences.en: and other forms of heavy industry here, none of which I want locating in Dallas.
sentences.zh: 以及其他形式的重工业，这些我都不希望落户达拉斯。

sentences.en: And he won.
sentences.zh: 而他赢了。

sentences.en: Soon after that, voters rejected a referendum to spend their tax dollars on the canal.
sentences.zh: 在那之后不久，选民们投票否决了一项将税款花在运河上的全民公投。

sentences.en: So right when the dream of those men aboard the snagboat Dallas of Dallas
sentences.zh: 因此，就在达拉斯号 snagboat（清除障碍船）上那些人的梦想

sentences.en: was finally on the cusp of reality,
sentences.zh: 终于即将变成现实的时候，

sentences.en: the dream was dead.
sentences.zh: 这个梦想破灭了。

sentences.en: Dallas would not become a port city.
sentences.zh: 达拉斯不会成为一个港口城市。

sentences.en: Which was really a shame.
sentences.zh: 这真的是个遗憾。

sentences.en: Not because Dallas needed to be a port,
sentences.zh: 不是因为达拉斯需要成为一个港口，

sentences.en: but because they totally messed up the natural landscape of the city.
sentences.zh: 而是因为他们把城市的自然景观彻底搞砸了。

sentences.en: Remember that the Port of Dallas project eventually included the Kessler Plan,
sentences.zh: 请记住，达拉斯港项目最终包括了凯斯勒计划，

sentences.en: which literally moved the river and channeled it into a man-made canal outside of town.
sentences.zh: 该计划字面意思上是将河流改道，并将其引入城外的人工运河中。

sentences.en: The Trinity River used to meander through the center of Dallas.
sentences.zh: 特里尼蒂河过去常常在达拉斯市中心蜿蜒流过。

sentences.en: It's hard to second-guess the civil engineering needs of the time.
sentences.zh: 很难去事后诸葛亮地评判当时的土木工程需求。

sentences.en: I mean, the river did flood the city pretty regularly.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这条河确实相当规律地淹没这座城市。

sentences.en: But one can't help but think that this could have been a nice riverfront for people to stroll along.
sentences.zh: 但人们不禁会想，这里本可以成为一条供人们漫步的迷人河滨。

sentences.en: A beloved piece of nature in the middle of the city.
sentences.zh: 城市中心一片备受喜爱的自然景致。

sentences.en: The Port of Dallas not only failed,
sentences.zh: 达拉斯港不仅失败了，

sentences.en: but it stole the natural riverfront from the people of Dallas.
sentences.zh: 而且它还从达拉斯人民手中偷走了天然的河滨。

sentences.en: Like a lot of people of my generation growing up in the 70s and 80s,
sentences.zh: 就像在 70 年代和 80 年代长大的我这一代人中的许多人一样，

sentences.en: I didn't really know there was a river in Dallas at all.
sentences.zh: 我以前根本不知道达拉斯有一条河。

sentences.en: You can kind of see the Trinity River in the title sequence of the TV show Dallas,
sentences.zh: 你偶尔能在 1978 年开播的电视剧《豪门恩怨》的片头中看到特里尼蒂河，

sentences.en: which launched in 1978,
sentences.zh: （注：剧名英文为 Dallas）

sentences.en: but the camera mostly lingers on the skyscrapers.
sentences.zh: 但镜头大多停留在摩天大楼上。

sentences.en: In real life, you might catch a glimpse of the river for a split second
sentences.zh: 在现实生活中，如果你从其中一座高速公路高架桥上往下看，

sentences.en: if you look down from one of those high freeway bridges.
sentences.zh: 也许能惊鸿一瞥地看到这条河一闪而过。

sentences.en: More often, you'd smell the river.
sentences.zh: 更多的时候，你会闻到河水的味道。

sentences.en: A lot of Dallas' untreated sewage got dumped there.
sentences.zh: 达拉斯许多未经处理的污水都被倾倒在那里。

sentences.en: In the 70s, there were, after a hard rain in Dallas,
sentences.zh: 在 70 年代，达拉斯下一场大雨之后，

sentences.en: this thing called the Black Rise would roil downstream and kill everything in its path.
sentences.zh: 会有被称为“黑色崛起”的东西顺流而下，杀死途中的一切生灵。

sentences.en: But toxic sludge wasn't the worst thing to turn up in the river.
sentences.zh: 但有毒污泥还不是河里出现的最糟糕的东西。

sentences.en: However, I'm talking about dead bodies.
sentences.zh: 然而，我说的是尸体。

sentences.en: The Trinity River bottom was the place where you'd hide the evidence.
sentences.zh: 特里尼蒂河底是藏匿证据的地方。

sentences.en: It was sketchy and unlit.
sentences.zh: 那里阴森昏暗且没有照明。

sentences.en: It was so dark that if you flew into Dallas at night,
sentences.zh: 天黑时如果你乘飞机飞往达拉斯，

sentences.en: you could pick out the floodway because it was completely invisible.
sentences.zh: 你可以辨认出防洪道，因为它完全隐形了。

sentences.en: This dark artery flowed through the heart of the city.
sentences.zh: 这条黑暗的动脉穿过城市的心脏。

sentences.en: You would never think of going there.
sentences.zh: 你绝不会想要去那里。

sentences.en: Never.
sentences.zh: 绝不。

sentences.en: But of course, Julia now had to go there.
sentences.zh: 但当然，茱莉亚现在必须去那里。

sentences.en: She got in a canoe.
sentences.zh: 她上了一艘独木舟。

sentences.en: Let's call it the Snag Canoe Dallas of Dallas.
sentences.zh: 我们暂且管它叫达拉斯清除障碍独木舟吧。

sentences.en: You see the snag at 12 o'clock?
sentences.zh: 你看到 12 点钟方向的那个障碍物了吗？

sentences.en: Are you going to go to the right or the left?
sentences.zh: 你是要向右走还是向左走？

sentences.en: The Trinity River resumes its natural winding course south of downtown Dallas.
sentences.zh: 特里尼蒂河在达拉斯市中心以南恢复了其天然的蜿蜒河道。

sentences.en: It flows through a dense hardwood foreSt.
sentences.zh: 它穿过一片茂密的硬木森林。

sentences.en: This part of the river bottom was left alone for decades
sentences.zh: 河底的这一部分几十年来一直无人问津，

sentences.en: because the plan was to someday bulldoze all this
sentences.zh: 因为当时的计划是有一天把这里全部推平，

sentences.en: into a big turning basin and loading area for barges.
sentences.zh: 变成一个供驳船停靠的大型回水盆地和装货区。

sentences.en: Now the Audubon Society has built a center at the edge of the forest
sentences.zh: 现在，奥杜邦协会在森林边缘建立了一个中心，

sentences.en: and it leads canoe and kayak rides for urban river explorers.
sentences.zh: 并为城市河流探索者组织独木舟和皮划艇之旅。

sentences.en: This is not the suburbs.
sentences.zh: 这里不是郊区。

sentences.en: This is not the country.
sentences.zh: 这里不是乡下。

sentences.en: This is the city.
sentences.zh: 这里是城市。

sentences.en: Oh, I'm going to be so sunburned.
sentences.zh: 哦，我会被晒得好惨。

sentences.en: So you've got 26 miles of river diverted into a walled-off artificial channel
sentences.zh: 所以你有 26 英里长的河流被改道流经筑墙隔离的人工渠道，

sentences.en: plus another long stretch shielded by dense foreSt.
sentences.zh: 再加上另一段被茂密森林遮蔽的漫长河段。

sentences.en: Making that easily accessible for public use
sentences.zh: 如何让公众轻松使用这些水域，

sentences.en: is the huge urban planning challenge that Dallas now has to contend with.
sentences.zh: 是达拉斯现在必须面对的巨大城市规划挑战。

sentences.en: The good news is that the people now realize
sentences.zh: 好消息是人们现在意识到，

sentences.en: that this man-made and man-neglected landscape is the river they have
sentences.zh: 这片人工开凿且遭人忽视的景观就是他们拥有的河流，

sentences.en: and that's better than pretending that they have no river at all.
sentences.zh: 总比假装他们根本没有河要好。

sentences.en: It's a strange place.
sentences.zh: 这是一个奇怪的地方。

sentences.en: It's not exactly comfortable
sentences.zh: 它谈不上舒适，

sentences.en: but not the nightmare of my childhood imagination either.
sentences.zh: 但也并非我童年想象中的噩梦。

sentences.en: It's a landscape stuck in anticipation of something that never happened.
sentences.zh: 这是一处滞留于对从未发生之事之期盼中的风景。

sentences.en: In the course of history,
sentences.zh: 在历史的长河中，

sentences.en: there are plenty of undertakings just as unlikely as the port of Dallas.
sentences.zh: 有许多与达拉斯港同样不可思议的工程。

sentences.en: We just don't think of the reversal of the Chicago River
sentences.zh: 我们只是没有把芝加哥河改道

sentences.en: or say the Panama Canal as follies or forget about them entirely
sentences.zh: 或者巴拿马运河视为愚蠢的傻事，也没有完全忘记它们，

sentences.en: because against all odds, they succeeded.
sentences.zh: 因为历经千难万险，它们成功了。

sentences.en: And they were crowned with much hat-wearing and machine-posing.
sentences.zh: 它们伴随着无数的戴帽庆祝和机器摆拍加冕。

sentences.en: But when an engineering endeavor fails,
sentences.zh: 但当一项工程努力失败时，

sentences.en: sometimes all we get are scars on the landscape.
sentences.zh: 有时我们得到的只有大地上留下的伤疤。

sentences.en: And if we're lucky, we get to try again.
sentences.zh: 如果我们足够幸运，我们还能再试一次。

sentences.en: Make something good out of it.
sentences.zh: 化腐朽为神奇。

sentences.en: Like a park.
sentences.zh: 比如建个公园。

sentences.en: Hopefully with a plaque.
sentences.zh: 最好还能立块牌匾。

sentences.en: I'd like it if they put up a plaque.
sentences.zh: 我希望他们能立一块牌匾。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Julia Barton
sentences.zh: 本周的《99%隐形》由茱莉亚·巴顿制作，

sentences.en: with Sam Greenspan, Katie Mingle, Avery Truffleman, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 合作者包括萨姆·格林斯潘、凯蒂·明格、艾弗里·特拉夫曼以及我，罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 Local Public Radio KALW in San Francisco
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山 91.7 本地公共广播电台 KALW 的一个项目，

sentences.en: and produced out of the offices of ArcSign,
sentences.zh: 在 ArcSign 的办公室制作，

sentences.en: an architecture firm in the beautiful downtown port of Oakland.
sentences.zh: 那是一家位于奥克兰美丽市中心港口的建筑事务所。

sentences.en: You can keep up with all the comings and goings of 99PI
sentences.zh: 你可以在 Twitter、Facebook、Tumblr、Instagram 和 Spotify 上

sentences.en: on Twitter, Facebook, Tumblr, Instagram, and Spotify.
sentences.zh: 关注 99PI 的所有动态。

sentences.en: I said hi to every single person who said hi to me on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 我在 Twitter 上向每一个跟我打招呼的人都打招呼了。

sentences.en: You thought I was kidding.
sentences.zh: 你以为我在开玩笑。

sentences.en: I was not kidding.
sentences.zh: 我可没开玩笑。

sentences.en: And you're always welcome at our place at 99PI.org.
sentences.zh: 欢迎随时访问我们在 99PI.org 的主页。
